inheritance.rationale: OrcaRouter reports identical Contributor/standard checkpoints; LLM Stats describes Contributor as a pricing/data-use tier. models.dev opencode entry explicitly lists this free route, zero input/output prices, text output and xhigh effort. This is a cross-route estimate, not a measured Zen result. models.dev does NOT advertise max for this route. Meta primary pricing docs (read 2026-09-26) list muse-spark-1.3 in both Standard and Contributor tiers, differing only in price and training-data use; effort parity is not stated there. Capabilities re-confirmed 2026-09-26 in fresh models.dev snapshot ($0 in/out, text-out, xhigh, not deprecated). Re-confirmed 2026-09-27: listed on the opencode.ai/docs/zen free list; Meta pricing docs list 1.3 in both tiers; source row now scored by the AA API (xhigh 45.1, v4.3.2).

OrcaRouter 1.2 article reports identical Contributor/standard checkpoint, same benchmarks, AA Index 57 for the family; LLMTR states Contributor is the same checkpoint with price/data-policy differences. models.dev opencode entry lists this free route with zero prices, text output and xhigh effort (deprecated flag noted, still listed). Cross-route estimate, not a measured Zen result. Meta primary pricing docs (read 2026-09-26) list muse-spark-1.2 in both tiers, differing only in price and training-data use. Route absent from the opencode.ai/docs/zen free list on 2026-09-26; expect removal. Capabilities re-confirmed 2026-09-26 in fresh models.dev snapshot ($0 in/out, text-out, xhigh, still flagged deprecated). 2026-09-27: still in the Zen API catalog but absent from the opencode.ai/docs/zen free list and flagged deprecated in models.dev; Meta pricing docs still list 1.2 in both tiers. Kept until the route leaves the catalog; route churn alerts on its removal.
